title: Archiving a tier moves the later tiers up one number
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier B, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier C, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Note tier A's number on the Tiers list (for example 5).
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Tiers tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Open tier A's three-dot menu on the Tiers list.
  3. Click Archive.
  4. Click Archive in the dialog.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Tier A, tier B and tier C have three numbers in a row (for example 5, 6 and 7).

Step 2:

  • The menu offers Archive.

Step 3:

  • The Archive question for tier A opens.

Step 4:

  • Tier B now has tier A's old number and tier C the next one (6 − 1 = 5, 7 − 1 = 6).
  • Tier B and tier C keep their names and order.
  • Tier A shows among the archived rows with no number.
